terra.problem: Calling self-feeding the whole charge overlooks the shepherds' neglect and cruel rule described in verse 4.
The oven joke makes light of the shepherds' serious neglect of vulnerable sheep.
Saying God doesn't send anybody else goes beyond the promise that He Himself will search. He also promises to appoint David as shepherd in verse 23.
Saying God doesn't hand the job to anybody goes beyond the text. He promises to appoint David as shepherd in verse 23.
The passage does not say the sheep aren't guarding anything. It says they trample the pasture.
The cited verses describe David tending sheep and being anointed, but do not identify him as king. Include 1 Samuel 16:1 for that fact.
